replies.author: Netuxx
replies.body:
Everytime you prestige you obtain a new Prestige LvL,
  • First time is Prestige LvL 1 (Pink)
  • Second is Prestige LvL 2 (Lime)
  • Prestige LvL 3 (Light Blue)
  • Prestige LvL 4 (Red)
  • And finally Prestige LvL 5 (Yellow)
